description.value: Alberni Colour Corner is Port Alberni's authorized independent Benjamin Moore paint retailer, operating since 2005 out of a retail unit on 10th Avenue. In addition to a full range of interior and exterior paints, the store stocks Titan airless sprayers, Level5 drywall equipment, custom blinds, flooring, and art supplies. Services include complimentary in-store colour consulting and colour matching, as well as paid in-home advising and Titan sprayer repair.

address.value: Unit 1 - 4310 10th Avenue, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 4X4
